# Subway Seat for btop

Every graph runs the 70s stripe, avocado to gold to orange to red, and the four boxes are outlined in orange, gold, avocado and terracotta.

[btop](https://github.com/aristocratos/btop) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/btop/)

## The quick way

```sh
curl -fsSL https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/install.sh | sh -s -- --only btop
```

The [installer](../../docs/INSTALL.md) shows its plan and asks once. Add `--flavor tunnel`, `--flavor enamel` or `--flavor auto` for another flavor. To do it yourself, use the files below.

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`subway-seat.theme`](subway-seat.theme) | `~/.config/btop/themes/subway-seat.theme` |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`subway-seat-tunnel.theme`](subway-seat-tunnel.theme) | `~/.config/btop/themes/subway-seat-tunnel.theme` |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`subway-seat-enamel.theme`](subway-seat-enamel.theme) | `~/.config/btop/themes/subway-seat-enamel.theme` |
| London Moquette | [`london-moquette.theme`](london-moquette.theme) | `~/.config/btop/themes/london-moquette.theme` |
| London Deep Level | [`london-deep-level.theme`](london-deep-level.theme) | `~/.config/btop/themes/london-deep-level.theme` |
| London Portland | [`london-portland.theme`](london-portland.theme) | `~/.config/btop/themes/london-portland.theme` |
| Paris Guimard | [`paris-guimard.theme`](paris-guimard.theme) | `~/.config/btop/themes/paris-guimard.theme` |
| Paris Catacombes | [`paris-catacombes.theme`](paris-catacombes.theme) | `~/.config/btop/themes/paris-catacombes.theme` |
| Paris Carrelage | [`paris-carrelage.theme`](paris-carrelage.theme) | `~/.config/btop/themes/paris-carrelage.theme` |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in ~/.config/btop/btop.conf, or Options › Color theme:

```conf
color_theme = "subway-seat"
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in ~/.config/btop/btop.conf, or Options › Color theme:

```conf
color_theme = "subway-seat-tunnel"
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in ~/.config/btop/btop.conf, or Options › Color theme:

```conf
color_theme = "subway-seat-enamel"
```

**London Moquette**, in ~/.config/btop/btop.conf, or Options › Color theme:

```conf
color_theme = "london-moquette"
```

**London Deep Level**, in ~/.config/btop/btop.conf, or Options › Color theme:

```conf
color_theme = "london-deep-level"
```

**London Portland**, in ~/.config/btop/btop.conf, or Options › Color theme:

```conf
color_theme = "london-portland"
```

**Paris Guimard**, in ~/.config/btop/btop.conf, or Options › Color theme:

```conf
color_theme = "paris-guimard"
```

**Paris Catacombes**, in ~/.config/btop/btop.conf, or Options › Color theme:

```conf
color_theme = "paris-catacombes"
```

**Paris Carrelage**, in ~/.config/btop/btop.conf, or Options › Color theme:

```conf
color_theme = "paris-carrelage"
```

## Uninstall

- Delete `~/.config/btop/themes/subway-seat.theme`.
- Delete `~/.config/btop/themes/subway-seat-tunnel.theme`.
- Delete `~/.config/btop/themes/subway-seat-enamel.theme`.
- Delete `~/.config/btop/themes/london-moquette.theme`.
- Delete `~/.config/btop/themes/london-deep-level.theme`.
- Delete `~/.config/btop/themes/london-portland.theme`.
- Delete `~/.config/btop/themes/paris-guimard.theme`.
- Delete `~/.config/btop/themes/paris-catacombes.theme`.
- Delete `~/.config/btop/themes/paris-carrelage.theme`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.
